items.title: Facebook is giving users more control over their algorithm
items.summary: Facebook is the latest social media platform to give users greater control over the algorithm that determines what appears in their feeds. Meta announced the launch of its new AI-powered feature, “Your Algorithm,” on Tuesday, a feature it first launched on Instagram. The new tool allows Facebook users to influence the content they see in […]

items.title: Forget rockets — Longshot wants to fire cargo into space from a gun. See it at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
items.summary: Longshot is trying to build a gun big enough to make space data centers a reality.

items.title: Laplace Intelligence red-teams robots and self-driving cars before they hit the real world
items.summary: University of Michigan spinout Laplace Intelligence uses AI agents and interactive simulation to stress-test robots and self-driving vehicles before deployment. The profitable startup is competing at TechCrunch Disrupt's Startup Battlefield.

items.title: Pluto Security raises $42M as AI gives enterprise security teams a new headache
items.summary: The problem with giving everyone in a company access to AI tools is that people will use them in unexpected ways. And that fact is steadily seeding fears that companies now have new, gaping security holes in their systems or, at least, will soon.

items.title: MIT startup says it can turn diesel trucks into cheaper hydrogen haulers — see it at Disrupt
items.summary: Diesel is expensive and polluting, and LNK Energies says it has come up with a way to replace it with hydrogen, all while undercutting diesel on cost.

items.title: Google Play now lets anyone build private, vibe-coded apps that run on Android
items.summary: Google is making it easier to build and use personal Android apps created with AI, without having to make them available to everyone on the Play Store.

items.title: SpaceX and Google both said no. Now his software is riding a SpaceX rocket next to Google’s
items.summary: Satlyt wants to be the Android of orbital computing, offering open software that works on many companies' satellites, versus SpaceX's closed, all-in-one iPhone-style approach.

items.title: The 2026 Startup Battlefield Top 20: From organs to orbit and everything in between
items.summary: Twenty founders just earned their shot at Disrupt glory. They're headed to the main stage at TechCrunch Disrupt to compete for the $100,000 prize and the coveted Disrupt Cup.

items.title: Spotify users on iOS 27 can now ask Siri to play music without having to say ‘on Spotify’
items.summary: Siri can now learn users' preferred music app, allowing Spotify listeners to request songs, podcasts, and playlists without specifying which app to use.

items.title: Bumble agrees to a $1.3B acquisition deal as online dating faces a reset
items.summary: After years of declining subscriber numbers and falling revenue, Bumble just agreed to a $1.3 billion acquisition.

items.title: SpaceXSI bundles X Premium, Grok, and Cursor into one subscription
items.summary: The new X Subscription combines X's paid features with AI tools like Grok and Cursor, offering plans ranging from $8 to $200 per month.

items.title: Apple refreshes its HomePod mini with a new chip and $149 price tag
items.summary: The new $149 HomePod mini with Siri AI and a 'SoundGlow' visual feature will be available starting October 30.

items.title: Apple’s new smart home lineup includes a smart lock, thermostat, and video doorbells
items.summary: The new devices work with HomeView, the company's new smart home hub which can be used to control accessories and interact with apps.

items.title: India delays digital payments fee rollout amid retailer pushback
items.summary: The NPCI, which operates the UPI network, said it was postponing the planned October 15 rollout of the 0.4% fee due to the festive shopping season.

items.title: Apple launches a new Apple TV 4K with Siri AI and remote-free voice commands
items.summary: The new Apple TV 4K costs $299, comes with Siri AI, and will be available on November 13.

items.title: Apple makes another push into the smart home market with HomeView
items.summary: Apple is taking a big swing at the smart home market with its latest product that competes with Amazon Echo Show and Google Nest Hub.

items.title: Amex introduces a framework to prevent AI agents from making unauthorized purchases
items.summary: American Express is introducing a new framework designed to ensure AI agents only make purchases their users have authorized, potentially preventing costly mistakes and disputes as AI-powered shopping grows.

items.title: Giraffe Bio aims its bespoke biomolecules at the looming copper shortage
items.summary: As AI data centers and EVs drive up demand for copper, Giraffe Bio has unearthed a $6.4 million seed round to help miners extract more of the mineral.
